rationale.en: The page says "independent estimates" but does not name the estimator or link to one. A search for an independent estimate of this plan's revenue cost, from the Legislative Analyst's Office or another nonpartisan source, found none, so the $40 billion figure could not be confirmed or contradicted. The page's own numbers are consistent with each other: it puts $40 billion at roughly 17.6 percent of the more than $226 billion in General Fund revenue it projects, and attributes about $20.9 billion of it to the first $150,000 exemption.
